name: Skalica
text: Skalica (; German: Skalitz, Hungarian: Szakolca) is a town in Slovakia in western Slovakia in the Záhorie region. It's the largest town in Skalica District. Located near the Czech border, Skalica has a population of around 15,000.

depictions.name: Skalitz
depictions.text: Skalitz (also known as Silver Skalitz, Silver Skalice, or Silberskalitz) is a wealthy settlement in Bohemia and Henry's home town. It was founded due to rich deposits of silver in the area; the mines were indeed the most important structure of the Sasau Region. In 1403 the settlement was under the administration of Sir Radzig Kobyla, a trusted man of King Wenceslas IV of Bohemia.
